issues.detail: The reported corrected widths are w_pm_1sigma = 72.3 pc and w_pm_2sigma = 143.7 pc, not an exact factor of two. The source states that physical widths are corrected by quadrature subtraction of the PSF.
The range 63.4–81.2 pc is derived from the uncertainty on one fitted stream width; the source does not declare it as a control domain for an exact width conversion.
